normative_sources: DL/PL2.0 §2.4 reserved fields; §2.4.2.5 No-Op; §2.4.4.1.2 UART Stream Reset; Tables2-12/13 Request/Response
limitations: Finite queue overflow locks a local fault; upper-level port recovery integration remains required.
No complete UART/TX/RX/normal arbiter or Credit Update cadence integration claim.
constraints: Native synchronous internal control interface; no AXI adaptation or new wire fields.
Every nonempty Verilog code line has a Chinese semantic comment.
One clock, synchronous low reset, one register peralways, no function/task orraw clock gating.
